home.title: Recogniz-Me
home.lead: Open the link provided by the company.

shell.privacy: Your images are sent only to the company that opened this session.

errors.invalidLead: Make sure you opened the full link you received from the company.
errors.expiredLead: Ask the company that sent it for a new link.
errors.networkLead: Check your internet connection, then try again.

consent.title: Let’s verify your identity
consent.lead: It only takes a few minutes. Keep your ID document at hand.
consent.stepDocumentLead: The front, then the back if it has one.
consent.stepFaceLead: A short capture to confirm it’s really you.
consent.body: We will photograph your identity document and your face to verify your identity. The images are sent to the company that opened this session.
consent.error: Consent could not be saved. Try again.

document.title: Photograph the front
document.lead: Lay the document flat and move closer so it fills the frame.
document.frame: Document frame: align the document in the rectangle.

documentBack.title: Turn the document over
documentBack.lead: Now photograph the back, up close. Wait until the text is sharp before you tap.
documentBack.frame: Back frame: align the back of the document in the rectangle.

selfie.title: Take a selfie
selfie.lead: Look at the camera, face unobstructed, in even light.
selfie.frame: Face frame: place your face in the oval.

liveness.title: Confirm you are present
liveness.lead: A short video confirms that the person in front of the camera is you.
liveness.tipHold: Hold the device at eye level and keep still
liveness.warningBody: This check flashes colors on the screen. Use caution if you or anyone in your family has an epileptic condition.
liveness.error: The face check failed. Try again.

livenessUi.hintMoveFaceFrontOfCameraText: Move your face in front of the camera
livenessUi.hintTooManyFacesText: Only one face should be visible
livenessUi.hintCanNotIdentifyText: Move your face in front of the camera
livenessUi.hintIlluminationTooBrightText: Too bright, move to a dimmer place
livenessUi.hintIlluminationTooDarkText: Too dark, move to a brighter place
livenessUi.hintCenterFaceInstructionText: Before starting, place the camera at the top center of your screen and center your face. An oval appears: move forward until your face fills it, then hold still for a few seconds.
livenessUi.hintFaceOffCenterText: Your face is not in the oval. Center it.
livenessUi.cameraMinSpecificationsMessageText: The camera must record at least 320 × 240 at 15 frames per second.
livenessUi.cameraNotFoundMessageText: Check that a camera is connected and no other app is using it. Allow camera access in your browser settings, then try again.
livenessUi.goodFitAltText: Illustration of a face that exactly fills the oval.
livenessUi.tooFarAltText: Illustration of a face that is too small in the oval.
livenessUi.photosensitivityWarningBodyText: This check flashes colors. Use caution if you are photosensitive.
livenessUi.photosensitivityWarningInfoText: Some people may have epileptic seizures when exposed to colored lights. Use caution if you or anyone in your family has an epileptic condition.
livenessUi.connectionTimeoutMessageText: The connection timed out. Check your network.
livenessUi.timeoutMessageText: Your face did not fill the oval in time. Try again and fill it completely.
livenessUi.faceDistanceMessageText: Do not move closer while connecting.
livenessUi.multipleFacesMessageText: Only one person should be in front of the camera.
livenessUi.clientMessageText: The check failed because of a problem on this device.
livenessUi.serverMessageText: The check could not finish because of a service problem.
livenessUi.landscapeMessageText: Turn your device to portrait (vertical) mode.
livenessUi.portraitMessageText: Keep the device in portrait mode for the whole check.

capture.analyzingLead: This can take a few seconds.
capture.recapture: The photo is not sharp enough. Try again.
capture.tooSmall: The photo is too small. Move closer to the document.
capture.tooDark: The photo is too dark. Add light, without flash.
capture.tooBright: Too much light or glare. Step away from a window or lamp.
capture.faceNotFramed: Place your face in the oval.
capture.decodeError: This photo cannot be read. Take another with the camera.

outcome.waitLead: We are verifying your information. Keep this page open.
outcome.doneLead: Your information has been sent. You can close this page.
outcome.closedLead: The company that sent you this link will tell you what happens next. You can close this page.
outcome.declinedLead: No photo was taken. You can close this page.
